name: munchkin-lan
description: A mobile-first LAN multiplayer card game foundation.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/web && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/server
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/contracts && npm run build --workspace @munchkin-lan/game-engine
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
